purpose: Separate user-selected disruption seeds from downstream disconnection, detour and additional load on other road links.

execution_tiers.name: Deterministic unit-OD all-or-nothing propagation
execution_tiers.claim: Network route sensitivity under a fixed disclosed proxy demand design

execution_tiers.name: Observed-flow-scaled Beckmann/BPR equilibrium
execution_tiers.claim: Capacity-constrained equilibrium response at an aggregate uploaded-flow scale. It does not reconstruct an unidentified OD matrix.

execution_tiers.name: MATSim exploratory-probe event propagation
required_data: positive free-flow travel time or derivable impedance
execution_tiers.claim: Event-derived queue, rerouting and disconnection sensitivity for a fixed deterministic probe population

execution_tiers.name: MATSim uploaded-demand event propagation
required_data: at least two routable directed links
positive road length and speed, travel time or free-flow time on every routable link
positive uploaded capacity on every routable link
execution_tiers.claim: Paired agent simulation with event-derived trip and link-load differences under the uploaded demand and supply assumptions

operators.closed: remove the selected directed road from the deterministic test; in the MATSim scenario, retain it with near-zero capacity and very low speed so affected agents can be observed as queued or stuck

primary_sources.citation: Horni, A., Nagel, K. and Axhausen, K.W. (eds.) (2016). The Multi-Agent Transport Simulation MATSim.
primary_sources.relationship: Supports the agent-plan, QSim event and iterative replanning tier.

primary_sources.citation: Wardrop (1952), Some theoretical aspects of road traffic research
Beckmann, McGuire and Winsten (1956), Studies in the Economics of Transportation
U.S. Bureau of Public Roads (1964), Traffic Assignment Manual
Jenelius, Petersen and Mattsson (2006), Importance and exposure in road network vulnerability analysis

known_limitations: Without a confirmed OD matrix, equal unit demand or MATSim probe agents form a sensitivity design, not observed traffic demand.
Observed-flow scaling matches an aggregate link-flow scale and does not reconstruct an unidentified OD matrix.
MATSim output depends on the declared population, supply, scoring, replanning, iteration, sample and seed contract.
A zero indirect-road count can coexist with severe disconnection when disrupted trips cannot complete a detour.
No hazard probability, casualty estimate or live traffic-control instruction is inferred.
verification: same demand design before and after disruption
completed, rerouted and disconnected demand reported separately
probe and uploaded-demand tiers never share the same interpretation
